offer_contrast.bounds: full assigned-arm risks [events/n_assigned,(events+unknown)/n_assigned], standardized with same all-randomized college weights; bounds on missing-data completions of the realized assigned-group contrast, not confidence intervals or bounds on a population causal effect
offer_contrast.causal_link: assignment effect requires consistency, no interference, comparable outcome ascertainment and justified missing-outcome handling; complete-case contrast alone is not an identified full ITT effect; uptake effect is not identified
offer_contrast.population: 1219 anchor baseline respondents randomized to offer within 16 colleges; 381 invited nonrespondents were not randomized
offer_contrast.positive_direction: offer minus no offer withdrawal risk
offer_contrast.primary: sum(college randomized n/1219 * (known-outcome offered risk - known-outcome control risk))
offer_contrast.randomization: uniform within-college assignment of half; odd college sizes have a fair random extra offer; original fixed assignments preserved
offer_contrast.sampling_inference: not supplied; sixteen sampled colleges do not establish future-system benefit
offer_contrast.unknown_labels: 11 consent-censored outcomes remain blank; 4 offered and 7 controls
offer_contrast.weights: all randomized respondents within each sampled college, not known-outcome n, invited n, population weights or equal-college weights

permutation.difference: permuted Brier minus unpermuted frozen-frame Brier
permutation.interpretation: descriptive sensitivity of this frozen model to this disruption on reused fixed records; permutation spread is not a sampling interval, causal effect or universal feature ranking
permutation.mapping: one bijection within each fixed college and role; permute prior_grade alone

prediction.comparator: 177/984 development prevalence independently reconstructed from 984 known no-offer anchor invitees
prediction.model: unchanged Unit 11 frame_only frozen model; prespecified teaching handoff, not selected by evaluation scores
prediction.outcome: withdrawal before first transfer by twelve months
prediction.prediction_time: enrollment snapshot with complete administrative frame
prediction.scoring: unweighted Brier and tied-pair AUC on identical records; no pooled setting score
